defs.def: to continue to be sth; to be still in the same state or condition 仍然是；保持不变

ex.s: He co-founded the Frank Lloyd Wright Building Conservancy, an organization engaged in the preservation of all of Wright’s remaining buildings.
ex.t: 他联合创立了弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特建筑保护协会，该组织致力于保护赖特现存的所有建筑。

ex.s: Hereford has remained a lively market town since 1189.
ex.t: 自1189年以来，赫里福德一直是一个充满活力的集镇。

ex.s: Staring at the bookcases in my study, packed with so many great books that had remained unread, I heard a loud voice in my head — “Shame on you!
ex.t: 凝视着我书房里塞满许多从未读过的好书的书架，我听到脑海里有个声音在大声说——“你真丢人！”

ex.s: However, hedgehogs remain open to others’ reactions and inputs.
ex.t: 然而，刺猬仍然对其他人的反应和意见持开放态度。

ex.s: From a 21st-century point of view, the printed book is certainly ancient, but it remains as interactive as any battery-powered e-reader.
ex.t: 从21世纪的视角看，印刷书当然古老，但它与任何电池供电的电子阅读器一样具有互动性。

ex.s: For now, grizzlies remain listed.
ex.t: 目前，灰熊仍在保护名录上。

ex.s: Yet Mik remained ______29______ .
ex.t: 然而米克始终____29____保持乐观。

ex.s: As time goes on, I remain____33____by the experience of witnessing a nine-year-old save a stranger's life.
ex.t: 随着时间的推移，我仍因目睹一名九岁孩子拯救陌生人的命的那段经历而____33____（震撼）。

ex.s: ●Teachers and chaperones should model good behavior for the group and remain with students at all times.
ex.t: ●老师和陪同人员应为团体树立良好榜样，始终与学生在一起。

ex.s: Tom has been awarded several prizes, but this teenage innovator remains humble.
ex.t: Tom已经获得了几个奖项，但这位年轻的创新者仍然谦虚。

ex.s: Indeed, it is thought that over four- fifths of living species on earth remain undiscovered.
ex.t: 事实上，据认为地球上超过五分之四的物种仍未被发现。

ex.s: It remains a family necessity.
ex.t: 它仍然是家庭必需品。

ex.s: Through it all, she remained in good academic standing and graduated with honors.
ex.t: 在整个过程中她保持了良好的学术成绩并以优异成绩毕业。

ex.s: I am, in part, an ant biologist, so my thoughts turned to what we know about insect life and I knew that much in the world of insects remains unknown.
ex.t: 我在一定程度上是一名蚂蚁生物学家，所以我的思绪转到我们对昆虫生命的了解上，我知道昆虫世界中仍有大量未知的事物。

ex.s: are remaining     B. have remained
ex.t: are remaining（正在保持） B. have remained（一直保持）

ex.s: is remaining      D. has remained
ex.t: is remaining（正在保持） D. has remained（一直保持）

ex.s: You should remain modest when approaching perfection.
ex.t: 在接近完美时，你仍应保持谦逊。

ex.s: It helps one to remain clear-headed and confident in difficult situations.
ex.t: 它帮助人们在困难情况下保持头脑清醒和自信。

ex.s: While restaurants ___41___ tons of food each year, much of it remains inaccessible because of ___42___ garbage containers, health regulations, or business policies.
ex.t: 虽然餐馆每年____41____（浪费）成吨的食物，但由于____42____（难以打开的）垃圾桶、卫生规定或商业政策，其中大部分仍然无法被获取。

ex.s: C．The living environment of other species will remain unchanged．
ex.t: C．其他物种的生存环境将保持不变。

ex.s: Pick, at random, Busuu in Cameroon (eight remaining speakers), Chiapaneco in Mexico(150).
ex.t: 随机挑选喀麦隆的布斯语（仅剩8名使用者）、墨西哥的奇帕内科语（150人）。

ex.s: While the decline over the past decade is steep for teen readers, some data in the report shows that reading remains a big part of many children’s lives, and indicates how parents might help encourage more reading.
ex.t: 虽然过去十年青少年读者的下降幅度很大，但报告中的一些数据显示阅读仍然是许多儿童生活中的重要部分，并表明家长可能如何帮助鼓励更多阅读。

ex.s: The report data shows that pleasure reading levels for younger children, ages 2-8, remain largely the same.
ex.t: 报告数据显示，2-8岁儿童的娱乐性阅读水平基本保持不变。

ex.s: If the consumer needs an amount of A costing 0.75, she can then spend only 0.25 X, the amount remaining, on her purchase of B.
ex.t: 然而，事实证明，这个概念——大多数消费者每天都会多次做出这个决定而不需要思考——是经济学中更正式的预算线概念的基础，下文将对此进行解释。

ex.s: It remains black and white.
ex.t: 它仍然是非黑即白的（保持原样）。

ex.s: I learned that Freddy did several jobs after his   52    from high school and remained the same  53    person I met forty years before.
ex.t: 我了解到弗雷迪高中____后做过几份工作，依然是我四十多年前遇到时的那个____样的人。

ex.s: I learned that Freddy did several jobs after his   52    from high school and remained the same  53    person I met forty years before .Once, while working overnight at a store, he let a homeless man   54   in his truck .
ex.t: 《远大前程》的出版既获得了广泛的好评又备受赞誉，巩固了狄更斯作为一流小说家的地位。

ex.s: Determining where we are _________our surroundings remains an essential skill for our survival.
ex.t: 确定我们相对于周围环境的方位，仍然是我们生存的一项基本技能。

ex.s: Second, if other factors such as technology remain constant, economic growth and material expectations will fall well below recent standards and this could invite trouble.
ex.t: 其次，如果技术等其他因素保持不变，经济增长和物质期望将远低于近期标准，这可能引发麻烦。

ex.s: Every animal sleeps, but the reason for this has remained foggy.
ex.t: 每种动物都会睡觉，但其中的原因一直模糊不清。

ex.s: Nowadays, we can move around the world and still stay in touch with the people that we want to remain friends with.
ex.t: 如今，我们可以在世界各地活动，仍然与我们想要保持友谊的人保持联系。

ex.s: Although technology has changed the way we acquire friends, the meaning of friendship and our longing for friends remain the same.
ex.t: 虽然科技改变了我们交友的方式，但友谊的意义和我们对于朋友的渴望依旧不变。

ex.s: Nowadays, we can…stay in touch with the people that we want to remain friends with.
ex.t: 如今，我们可以……与我们想要保持友谊的人保持联系。

ex.s: Eating out may change the form of this tradition, but the love between the family members sitting around the table together remains the same.
ex.t: 外出就餐可能会改变这种传统的形式，但家人围坐桌旁的那份亲情依然不变。

ex.s: While rock-climbing, you need to remain very                  so that you won't make any  dangerous errors.
ex.t: 攀岩时你需要保持                  以免犯危险错误。

defs.def: to still be present after the other parts have been removed, used, etc; to continue to exist 剩余；遗留；继续存在

ex.s: In around 8 A.Q., the Romans built the Colosseum, which remains the world's best known stadium are continues to inform contemporary design.
ex.t: 大约在公元80年，罗马人建造了斗兽场，它至今仍是世界上最著名的体育场，并持续影响着当代设计。

ex.s: Although the studies led by Navajas have limitations and many questions remain the potential implications for group discussion and decision-making are enormous.
ex.t: 尽管纳瓦哈斯主导的研究存在局限性且仍有许多问题未解决，但其对小组讨论和决策的潜在影响是巨大的。

ex.s: By the early 1970s, after centuries of cruel and continuous hunting by settlers, 600 to 800 grizzlies remained on a mere 2 percent of their former range in the Northern Rockies.
ex.t: 到20世纪70年代初，经过定居者数百年来残酷而持续的猎杀，灰熊只剩下600到800头，仅分布于北落基山脉昔日活动范围的2%。

ex.s: What will remain of us when artificial intelligence takes over will be our creativity, and it is our creative spirit, our visionary sense of freshness,that has been our strength for centuries."
ex.t: 当人工智能接管一切时，我们留下的将是什么？将是我们创造力；正是我们富有创意的精神、我们对新鲜事物的远见，几个世纪以来一直是我们的力量所在。

ex.s: We want to remain friends with them.
ex.t: 我们想继续和他们做朋友。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了人类在大约30万年前进化时所有语音就已经存在的流行观点。"我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来不一定保持稳定，相反，我们今天发现的巨大语音多样性是生物变化和文化进化等复杂相互作用的结果，"研究团队成员Steven Moran说。

defs.def: to still need to be done, said, or dealt with 仍需去做（或说、处理）

ex.s: Granddaughter Gayle Parks，31-who works alongside her in the family business-said it remained unknown as to who nominated Irene for the award.
ex.t: 31岁的孙女盖尔·帕克斯——她在家族企业中和奶奶一起工作——说目前还不清楚是谁提名艾琳参选这个奖项的。

defs.def: to stay in the same place; to not leave 逗留；不离去
